title: Position bounded by the number of visited cells
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols and state set $S$, let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $t\in\bbn$, and let $i<k$ be a work-tape index. If $z\in\bbz$ is a position occupied by the head of tape $i$ at some time from $0$ through $t$, inclusive, then $|z|$ is strictly less than the number of distinct positions occupied by that head during those times.
